entries.250f9b3a69849135: Owners and management companies of rental properties
entries.37567af30567b103: For owners of condominiums, apartments and other rental properties, the company provides an internet connection service under which all units are covered by one contract and residents can use it free of charge without limit. Services are offered under the company's own FGBB series brand and under private brands (PB). Demand from student dormitories is also increasing.
entries.37e5265ab02cda64: Operators of tourist facilities, stores and commercial facilities
entries.37e911ad103368d3: Through consolidated subsidiary FG Smart Asset Inc., the company operates real estate sales and leasing businesses.
entries.5a26a6e6f1c879e5: For facility operators, the company provides the free Wi-Fi service "Wi-Fi Nex®", and also offers "SHINOBI Wi-Fi®" for inbound foreign visitors to Japan, "Wi-Fi BUS®" for sightseeing buses and excursion boats, and "One-Touch Wi-Fi", which can be set up with simple operations. For corporate customers, it provides network solutions such as internet connection, internet service provider services and internet VPN, and for nursing care facilities and hospitals it provides Wi-Fi environments linked with ICT devices.

entries.d2098665211769df: This is an "Other" business not included in reportable segments. Through consolidated subsidiaries Offgrid Lab Inc., Power Denki Innovation Inc. and Smart Green Inc., the company is commissioned to install solar panels, storage batteries and other equipment in apartment buildings, hospitals, factories and warehouses.
entries.e04814393fab03c7: The core of this business is laying optical fiber lines in apartment buildings and installing Wi-Fi equipment to provide internet access to residents, and it also includes free Wi-Fi for nursing care facilities, commercial facilities and events, and construction of corporate networks. The company develops its communications equipment in-house and provides Wi-Fi environment construction, operation and customer support on an end-to-end basis. Consolidated subsidiary NOIS Inc. handles the intermediation of communications lines, and Feibo Wangtong Keji Gufen Youxian Gongsi handles product equipment development and call center operations.
